verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships as a full ISO installer that takes over the whole machine as reported by hands-on users, confirming it can replace an existing OS installation (and Omarchy Quattro even supports installing alongside Windows on a single partition). missing for 10: no first-party step-by-step docs on wiping/replacing an existing OS, and some community reports of install-script quirks (overwriting login manager, single-user assumptions) suggest rough edges in a clean 'replace in place' flow.
